useOneFewerObservation: Uses count − 1 while reconstructing the total.
useOneMoreObservation: Uses count + 1 while reconstructing the total.
countOffByOneLow: Returns one fewer observation than the exact count.
countOffByOneHigh: Returns one more observation than the exact count.
assumeMissingEqualsAverage: Assumes the missing observation must equal the average.
arithmeticOffsetLow: Makes a small downward arithmetic error after using the right method.
arithmeticOffsetHigh: Makes a small upward arithmetic error after using the right method.
